test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: P, Q, R, S and T are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Neither Q nor S sit at the exact central position of the row. R is adjacent to S, while P and T are sitting at the extreme ends of the row. Who is sitting at the exact central position of the row?
solution:
step 1) Q and S are not sitting at the exact central position. Step 2) P and T are sitting at the extreme ends of the row. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0013740a7cb03e67ba7b41e593778ab3dbea036dd558ed5891179a6f4205862e.png] 

Step 3) **R** is adjacent to S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45f64681b815f9072408372fdc71d0c0c0822ba6e10118c5642b0a5b9b73a9eb.png] 

 

**Hence, *'R is sitting at the exact central position of the row.'***

Thus, the correct answer is* ****'Option 2'.***
